modifications: Selected definitions; direct Torch/Triton imports and Torch device SM-count adapter. Explicit IEEE input_precision in tl.dot preserves FP32; FP32 persistent tile N=32/stages=2 and FP16 N=128 use constrained-shared-memory configurations as in later upstream support. No hand-written GPU algorithm.

softmax_source.modifications: None except formatting. CUDA _softmax adapter preserves half_to_float; high-level softmax retains native dtype casting.

integration: Only CUDA backend operations are replaced. FP16/BF16 softmax and log-softmax accumulate in FP32 and return native requested dtypes; aten::softmax frontend dtype casting is preserved.

mean_source.modifications: Accumulator initializes as FP64 for FP64 input, otherwise original FP32, preserving answer-score precision; no change to reduction layout/algorithm. Worker adapter preserves output dtype and scalar/empty/multi-axis semantics.
